svg.title: The live session map
svg.desc: A map of seven Claude Code sessions and one Codex session as the page draws them live: working cards with a light turning around the frame, the Codex card, marked with its Codex tag, turning yellow with an inferred mark when a command waits for your permission, a helper turning green when it is done, a stopped grey card, a dashed next step, and a closed session fading off the map. The names are invented.
